financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM Sales Agreement issuances after June 30, 2025 (20,891,304 shares)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: Subsequent to June 30, 2025, the Company issued 20,891,304 shares of common stock under the ATM Sales Agreement for net proceeds of $6.6 million.

warrants.quote: we agreed to issue to the Investor common stock warrants to purchase up to 1,237,113 shares (the “Common Warrants”) at an exercise price of $2.95 per share.
Each Warrant has an exercise price of $0.85 and was immediately exercisable upon issuance. The Series B-1 Common Warrants will expire on the five-year anniversary of the date of issuance
the Series B-2 Common Warrants will expire on the eighteen-month anniversary of the date of issuance.
